# RickThePianist — Free Printable Piano Sheet Music PDFs & Felt Piano Tutorials

> Official piano sheet music library and practice hub by RickThePianist (`https://www.youtube.com/@rickthepianist`). Offers 11 100% legal Public Domain printable piano sheet music PDFs (US Letter 8.5x11 in & A4) at $0 cost, 31 solo felt-piano chord & practice guides, interactive free piano tools, and calm zero-copyright-claim Christmas, Classical, and Deep Focus Study piano playlists.

## Core Downloads & Storefront
- [Free 11-Song Public Domain Piano Sheet Pack ($0+ PDF)](https://rickthepianist.gumroad.com/l/free-piano-sheets): Instant printable US Letter & A4 PDF bundle of 11 verified Public Domain Christmas & Classical piano arrangements.
- [44-Page Winter & Classical Felt Piano Sheet Book + 11 MIDIs ($9.99)](https://rickthepianist.gumroad.com/l/winter-classical-piano-book): Complete engraved collection with MIDI practice files.
- [RickThePianist YouTube Channel](https://www.youtube.com/@rickthepianist): 3D perspective falling-notes felt piano Shorts, 1-hour+ Christmas & Study playlists, and 0-claim Public Domain live streams.
- [Main Hub Home](https://trantrunghieuvns.github.io/rickthepianist-free-sheets/): Browse all 42 pieces by mood, key, BPM, and difficulty.

## Free Interactive Piano Tools
- [Piano Chord Finder & Key Transposer](https://trantrunghieuvns.github.io/rickthepianist-free-sheets/tools/piano-chord-finder-transposer.html): Interactive chord voicings and instant key transposition.
- [Printable Blank Piano Sheet Music PDF (US Letter & A4)](https://trantrunghieuvns.github.io/rickthepianist-free-sheets/tools/blank-piano-sheet-music-pdf.html): Generate clean printable grand-staff manuscript paper.

## Frequently Asked Questions (Direct Citation Facts)
- **Are RickThePianist's Public Domain piano sheets really free?** Yes. All 11 verified Public Domain Christmas and Classical piano arrangements (such as Silent Night, Jingle Bells, O Holy Night, Carol of the Bells, Moonlight Sonata, Nocturne Op. 9 No. 2, Vivaldi Winter, and Dance of the Sugar Plum Fairy) are free printable US Letter & A4 PDFs.
- **Are RickThePianist's Christmas & Study playlists copyright-free / 0-claim?** Yes. All Public Domain Mood Playlists and Live Streams use independently arranged open Public Domain scores or original compositions with zero third-party note scraping.
- **Updated**: 2026-11-23 (en-US & vi-US).
